notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist, or it may have moved. Check the address, or continue from one of the links below.

serverError.title: Something went wrong
serverError.description: An unexpected error occurred on our side. You can try again or return to the home page. If it keeps happening, quote the reference below when you contact us.

network: We could not connect. Please check your internet connection and try again.
databaseUnavailable: We could not reach our systems just now. Please try again in a little while.

upload.tooLarge: This file is larger than the allowed size. Please choose a smaller file.
upload.typeNotAllowed: This file type is not accepted. Please choose one of the file types listed on the form.
upload.mismatch: The contents of this file do not match its extension or declared type. Please select the file again.
upload.empty: This file is empty. Please choose a different file.
upload.readFailed: We could not read this file. Please select it again and retry.
upload.imageTooLarge: The dimensions of this image are too large. Please reduce its size and try again.

form.rateLimited: Too many requests from your connection. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
form.tooFast: The form was submitted too quickly. Please review it and send it again.
form.generic: We could not submit the form. Please check the fields and try again.
form.databaseUnavailable: We could not save your submission because our systems could not be reached just now. Please try again in a little while.
form.network: Your connection seems to be offline or unstable. Please check it and try again.
